create_dataset_with_index: create a dataset class that returns image, target, and sample index on each getitem call
create_enumerated_targets_dataset: create a DatasetWithEnumeratedTargets wrapper that adds sample indices to dataset targets
pad_dataset_for_distributed: pad a dataset to a multiple of world size for distributed training with drop_last false
get_image_relpath_from_adapter: get the relative file path of an image at a given index from the wrapped dataset
get_target_with_enumeration: get a target tuple containing the sample index and original target from the adapter
